spans.text: Lussuria’s “clergy”, as it’s best described, is made up of those who have devoted themselves to her pursuit of influence and power. They pledge themselves to care for their mistress’ fleeting desires, as well as empowering the downtrodden. Though never directly under the name of their collective organization (the Celestial Brothel), her followers tend to open institutions that serve both as hidden temples to Lussuria and houses of pleasure.
